_comment: The phone widget's sizes, read by widget-preview.sh. Boxes are dp, measured off the human's S25 home-screen screenshot of 2026-11-09 (1080x2340 px, 2.625 px per dp): the full 4x5 widget is 938x1574 px = 357x600 dp, so one grid row is 120 dp. must_show lists the section titles that must stay inside the box when that section is present; '*' means nothing may clip.
